title: Credit Policy Clause: Open Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Contracts per Customer
content:
**Credit Policy, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — limit on open contracts.**

1. A customer may hold at most **3** open Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts at the same time.
2. A contract counts as open in every status except paid in full, closed and charged off; a contract still pending funding counts.
3. A booking that would exceed the cap is declined at funding review and is never booked.
4. Contracts held in other Kestrel products do not count toward this cap.

## Counting table

| Status of an existing new-vehicle retail contract | Counts toward the 3-contract cap |
|---|---|
| Pending funding | Yes |
| Active, repossession assigned, repossessed, or deficiency | Yes |
| Paid in full, closed, or charged off | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer holds two active new-vehicle retail contracts and one pending funding: that is 3 open contracts, so a fourth booking would exceed the cap and is declined at funding review.
- A customer holds three new-vehicle retail contracts, one of them paid in full: 2 count as open, so one further booking brings the count to 3 and does not exceed the cap.
- A customer holds two new-vehicle retail contracts and a Kestrel lease: the lease does not count; 2 contracts count.
